cites.stt: Some scientists are serious about resurrecting zeppelins for cargo
cites.x: According to Sam Burton of The Federal Helium Program [1], we have at-least 100 years worth of Helium in Wyoming with the current supply and demand. This is before taking into account new sources.

cites.stt: Will We Run Out of Helium?
Buoyant wants to solve middle-mile delivery with cargo airships
cites.x: The common trope is that "The world is running out of Helium", yet it seems like that is not actually true [1][2]. I'd be interested to hear how this is all being taken into account.
